meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把一份 DAG 定义存成 JSON 文件放进技能库，之后按名字重新运行，不用每次把定义复制粘贴一遍。保存时写入 $HOME/.omo/dags 或项目里的 .omo/dags。
howto.when: 当你想保存一份 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG，或反复调度同一个多智能体图时触发。若只是要写一张全新的图，应先读 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把当前的 DAG 存成 nightly-audit，放到我主目录的库里
say.note: 写入 ~/.omo/dags 并试跑一次确认
key 轮转为带 UTC 时间戳的新运行
复用该次运行，便于失败节点恢复

howto.what_en: With this skill Claude saves a DAG definition as a JSON file in a library and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. It writes to $HOME/.omo/dags or a project .omo/dags.
howto.when_en: Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. For authoring a brand-new graph, read mass-ulw first.

say_en.text: Save this DAG as nightly-audit in my home library
say_en.note: Writes it to ~/.omo/dags and runs it once
The key rotates to a fresh timestamped run
Reuses that run for idempotent recovery
